cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two biscuits missing. Please don't refill the tin until I've established the weakness in our stock controls.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ate them. That's the mystery solved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The eater is not the weakness. Who issued you two biscuits without recording the withdrawal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. I was hungry and the tin was open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Uncontrolled access and no meal provision. Write both down, separately. Apparently I'm auditing the whole break room before I can have a biscuit.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 stock-control investigation and A3 distinction between eater and weakness make A expert reasoning turn tiny details into system problems.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 admission causes A3 issuance inquiry; B4 hunger and open tin cause A5 two broad failings.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 explain ordinary use of biscuits and try to end the inquiry.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands scope from biscuits to access and food provision after B4 simple explanation.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 final audit-before-biscuit summary explains the scale instead of directing a useful next action.
